title: ScriptedUtils
description: Items and functions to make your scripted server or events better
body:
This mod adds a few features to make scripted servers and events easier.
### 
### 1. The candles
     When someone types "/helputil", they will get this text:
     HELP:
     Magenta: Teleports all players in survival to the place you are looking at
     Cyan: Deletes a cube around you
     Brown: Builds a bedrock box and teleports all players in survival

### 2. Commands
   There are 2 commands in the mod (without "/helputil"):

    "/plotarmortoggle" changes some attributes to make fights easier to win without looking suspicious in videos

    "/Invistoggle" doesn’t work yet
### 
### 5. Gamerule
     There is one gamerule that disables chat for every player in survival mode

### 6. Everything else
   When a player dies, they will change gamemode to spectator, and a fake leave message will appear (for hardcore scripted servers) after a random time between 1 and 3 seconds.
   They can’t send messages in chat.
